# spirv-cross (win-x64)

This directory contains pre-built binaries and licensing information for `spirv-cross`.

* Upstream Source: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Cross
* License: Apache License 2.0. See `LICENSE.Apache-2.0.txt`.
* Build Target: Windows x86_64 (MinGW-w64 static runtime)
* Usage: Distributed alongside MercuryManager.Server for converting SPIR-V shaders to GLSL/ESSL shaders for in-browser WebGL/WebGPU preview.
